name: api-hero
description: Git-first REST/HTTP client for VS Code plus headless apihero CLI and MCP. Edit .api requests in a UI Request Editor, run with assertions, orchestrate Scenarios, manage Authentication (profiles, Login API sessions, Secret Storage), collections, and environments, import OpenAPI / Postman / Insomnia / cURL, inspect Execution, History, and Run Reports, and run the same collections from CI or AI agents.

viewsWelcome.contents:
No collections yet.
Open a folder workspace, create a collection, then add a request — or import OpenAPI / Postman / Insomnia / cURL.

[New Collection](command:apiHero.createCollection)
[New Request](command:apiHero.createRequest)
[Import OpenAPI](command:apiHero.importOpenApi)
[Import Postman](command:apiHero.importPostman)
[Import Insomnia](command:apiHero.importInsomnia)
[Import cURL](command:apiHero.importCurl)

[Open Overview](command:apiHero.openOverview)

No scenarios yet.
Collection Runner executes many requests. A Scenario automates one API workflow with branches and shared data.
Create one under `.apihero/scenarios/` or pick a starter template.

[New Scenario](command:apiHero.createScenario)
[Open Overview](command:apiHero.openOverview)

No collection runs yet.
Run a collection, folder, or selected requests from Collections — live progress appears here.

[Focus Collections](command:apiHero.focusCollections)
[Open Overview](command:apiHero.openOverview)

No request history yet.
History lists past runs (metadata only — not request files; response bodies are not stored).

[Focus Collections](command:apiHero.focusCollections)
[Open Overview](command:apiHero.openOverview)

apiHero.logLevel.description: Minimum severity written to the API Hero output channel.

apiHero.requestTimeout.description: Default HTTP request timeout in milliseconds. Set to 0 to disable the timeout. Per-request @timeout overrides this default when present.

apiHero.maxResponseBytes.description: Maximum buffered HTTP response body size in bytes. When exceeded during download, the request fails with RESPONSE_TOO_LARGE. Set to 0 for no limit.

apiHero.history.maxEntries.description: Maximum number of request history entries to retain. Newest entries are kept when the limit is exceeded.

apiHero.variables.global.description: Global API Hero variables (User settings). Sensitive values are masked in language and response UI; prefer Secret Storage for credentials via Manage Authentication.

apiHero.variables.workspace.description: Workspace API Hero variables. Do not commit secrets in workspace settings; use Manage Authentication / Secret Storage for credentials.

apiHero.environments.description: Named API Hero environments (id, name, variables). Prefer Manage Environments for day-to-day edits. At most one environment is active via apiHero.activeEnvironment.

apiHero.activeEnvironment.description: ID of the active named environment (matches an entry in apiHero.environments). Leave empty or omit to use no environment.

apiHero.authentication.profiles.description: Named authentication profile metadata (none / basic / bearer / apiKey). Prefer Manage Authentication. Secret sources use VS Code Secret Storage; literal sources require unsafe: true.

apiHero.import.maxFileBytes.description: Maximum OpenAPI specification file size in bytes accepted by Import OpenAPI Specification. Larger files are rejected with a clear error.

enumDescriptions: Prompt for a failure policy before each collection, folder, or selected-requests run.
Stop the run after the first failed or invalid request; remaining requests are skipped.
Continue running remaining requests after failures.
Skip unread or invalid requests and continue; execution failures also continue.
apiHero.collectionRunner.failurePolicy.description: Default failure policy for collection, folder, and selected-request runs. When set to ask, API Hero prompts before each run; otherwise the chosen policy is used without a QuickPick.

apiHero.collectionRunner.retryEnabled.description: Default whether collection runs retry eligible transport failures (network, 408/429/502/503/504). The Run Options QuickPick pre-selects this value.

apiHero.collectionRunner.maxRetries.description: Default max retries after the initial attempt when collection-run retry is enabled (total attempts = maxRetries + 1).

apiHero.collectionRunner.retryDelayMs.description: Default base delay in milliseconds between collection-run retry attempts.

enumDescriptions: Wait the same delayMs between every retry.
apiHero.collectionRunner.retryBackoff.description: Default backoff strategy for collection-run retries when retry is enabled.

apiHero.collectionRunner.skipDestructive.description: Default whether collection runs skip DELETE requests. The Run Options QuickPick pre-selects this value.

apiHero.languageFeatures.hover.description: Show documentation hovers when editing .api files.

apiHero.languageFeatures.outline.description: Show request symbols in the Outline view for .api files.

apiHero.languageFeatures.diagnostics.description: Show lightweight syntax diagnostics for .api files in the Problems panel.

scripts.prepack: npm run compile && npm run bundle
scripts.package: npm run clean && npm run build && npm test && node ./scripts/package-vsix.mjs
scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run compile && npm run bundle:vsix
